description: Déploiement fibre optique - Communes zones initiatives privées - Territoire d'Agglopolys is a dataset listed in Blois-Agglopolys open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Val de Loire Numérique. Dans le cadre du programme national Plan France Très Haut Débit (PFTHD) qui vise à couvrir l’ensemble du territoire français en très haut débit fin 2023, l’État mobilise les acteurs publics et privés. Coverage: Agglopolys, Blois (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Numérique. Its keywords are fibre, ftth, tres haut debit. The portal shows 26 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-01-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-blois-agglopolys-fr-portal.
